description: 播放原地伸展动作，适合作为安静的互动功能。
imagePrompt: Create exactly four temporally ordered frames of the same subject beginning a natural stretch, extending the body, holding the fullest comfortable stretch, and returning toward the neutral pose. Keep identity, opaque visual mass, camera distance, centroid and baseline stable; keep every extremity complete and inside its cell. No props, text, labels or speech bubbles.
